segments.name: U.S. and Latin America
products: Individual and group life and health reinsurance
segments.description: Provides traditional life and health reinsurance and asset-intensive reinsurance solutions primarily to U.S. life insurance companies.
segments.evidence: The U.S. and Latin America operations includes traditional life and health reinsurance, asset-intensive transactions, financial reinsurance, a funding agreement backed note program and other capital motivated solutions, primarily to U.S. life insurance companies.

revenueModel.text: Insurance companies pay premiums to RGA for assuming mortality, morbidity, lapse and investment-related risks on reinsured life and health insurance products.
revenueModel.evidence: The Company obtains substantially all of its revenues through reinsurance agreements that cover a portfolio of life and health insurance products, including term life, credit life, universal life, whole life, group life and health, joint and last survivor insurance, critical illness, disability, longevity as well as asset-intensive (e.g., annuities), financial reinsurance and other capital motivated solutions.
